name: Azure Functions
summary: Function app with keyless (identity-based) storage access, on a Consumption or a Premium/Dedicated plan, HTTPS only and private by default.
useWhen: You need event-driven or scheduled serverless compute (timers, queue triggers, HTTP APIs, Event Grid handlers)
You want to pay per execution rather than for reserved compute (Consumption plan)
avoidWhen: You need a long-running process with no natural trigger or timeout (use Container Apps or App Service)
You need Consumption-plan cold start eliminated and no VNet limits (use a Premium plan instead of Consumption, still this module, different serverFarmResourceId)
